title: Home Purchase Financing Hardship Program — Amount of the Good-Faith Payment
content:
**Calculation clause — the good-faith payment on a Home Purchase Financing loan**

(1) The installments past due are the unpaid installments falling due on or before the payment date, that is the whole months from the oldest unpaid installment's due date to the payment date plus one.

(2) The principal and interest past due is the monthly principal-and-interest amount times the installments past due.

(3) The good-faith payment is 25 percent of the principal and interest past due, rounded half up to the cent.

### Worked example (hypothetical loan)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Monthly principal and interest | 521.37 |
| Oldest unpaid installment due | 2026-02-15 |
| Payment date | 2026-04-02 |

- Whole months from 2026-02-15 to 2026-04-02: one (2026-03-15); the days to 2026-04-02 do not make a second. Installments past due: one plus one, that is 2 — the installments due 2026-02-15 and 2026-03-15, both on or before the payment date.
- Principal and interest past due: 521.37 times 2, that is 1042.74.
- Good-faith payment: 25 percent of 1042.74 is 260.685, rounded half up to 260.69.

*Same loan, payment date 2026-04-15:* the whole months are now two, the installments past due three (including the installment due that day), the principal and interest past due 1564.11, and the good-faith payment 391.0275, rounded to 391.03.
